1a) secret place
1b) hiding place

elsewhere.note: He lies in wait near the villages. From ambushes, he murders the innocent. His eyes are secretly set against the helpless.
I will give you the treasures of darkness and hidden riches of secret places, that you may know that it is I, Yahweh, who call you by your name, even the God…
But if you will not hear it, my soul will weep in secret for your pride. My eye will weep bitterly, and run down with tears, because Yahweh’s flock has been…
He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
You pierced the heads of his warriors with their own spears. They came as a whirlwind to scatter me, gloating as if to devour the wretched in secret.
